title: Never Lose a Domain to a Missed Renewal
summary: List every domain, DNS record and renewal date in one place, watch the receipts and renewal emails, and get reminders early, so a lapsed domain never takes your site or email down.

money_potential.label: Low
money_potential.basis: Assumes your site and email depend on domains you renew yourself; the value is time saved and avoiding a lapse.
money_potential.note: Value tiers are our rough estimates (labelled Estimate) of relative value to the business, each with its assumption. They are not promises, income claims or advice. Results depend on your market, offer and effort.

how_it_makes_money: No lost sales from a site or inbox that went dark.

steps.name: Spaceship Hosting
steps.does: Lists domains, DNS and renewal dates

steps: List every domain and its renewal date.
Check that auto-renew and billing are current.
Set reminders ahead of each renewal.
Approve any DNS change one at a time.
guardrails: Every DNS change is shown first and needs your yes.
Write down current DNS records before any edit.
